Get Started

Your seed phrase is the only thing that can regenerate your ML-KEM-768 (encryption) and ML-DSA-65 (signing) keypairs. There is no password and nothing else to remember — treat it exactly like a crypto wallet seed phrase.

Create New Seed Phrase

This generates a 24-word seed phrase (256 bits of entropy), then deterministically derives your ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 keypairs from it. Anyone with these 24 words can regenerate both private keys — write them down somewhere offline and safe.

This is shown only once. Nothing is saved anywhere by this page. If you lose these words, your keys — and anything encrypted to them — are gone for good.
Unlock with Seed Phrase

Enter your 12 or 24-word seed phrase, separated by spaces, in order.

Active Keys Control Private Keys Active in Memory

Public keys are hidden from display. Click below to copy your public keys to the clipboard for sharing. Verify public key fingerprints with your counterparty out-of-band before trusting them.

Sign & Encrypt Message for Recipient

Signs the message with your ML-DSA-65 key, then encrypts message+signature to the recipient's ML-KEM-768 public key.

Decrypt & Verify Message

Decrypts using your ML-KEM-768 key, then verifies the recovered signature against the sender's ML-DSA-65 public key.
